mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_task /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.insertDesign */ ( task_name, task_des, task_status, is_test, is_design, pt_task_id, de_task_id, task_depth, task_st, task_et, task_rst, task_ret, task_asi, task_rate, pjt_id, user_id ) VALUES ( #{taskName}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskDes}, ''), ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskStatus}, ''), '대기'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{isTest}, ''), 0), #{isDesign}, CASE WHEN #{ptTaskId} IS NOT NULL AND #{ptTaskId} != '' AND #{ptTaskId} != '0' THEN #{ptTaskId} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{isDesign} = 1 THEN NULL WHEN #{isDesign} = 0 THEN #{ptTaskId} ELSE NULL END, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskDepth}, ''), 1), NULLIF(#{taskSt}, ''), NULLIF(#{taskEt}, ''), NULLIF(#{taskRst}, ''), NULLIF(#{taskRet}, ''), COALESCE( NULLIF(#{taskAsi}, ''), (SELECT name FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}) ), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskRate}, ''), 0), #{pjtId}, #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE project_task /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.updateDesign */ SET task_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskName}, ''), task_name), task_des = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskDes}, ''), task_des), task_status = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskStatus}, ''), task_status), is_test = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{isTest}, ''), is_test), task_depth = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskDepth}, ''), task_depth), pt_task_id = CASE WHEN #{ptTaskId} IS NULL THEN pt_task_id -- 기존값 유지 WHEN #{ptTaskId} = '' OR #{ptTaskId} = '0' THEN NULL ELSE #{ptTaskId} END , de_task_id = CASE WHEN #{isDesign} = 1 THEN NULL WHEN #{isDesign} = 0 THEN #{ptTaskId} END, task_st = NULLIF(#{taskSt}, ''), task_et = NULLIF(#{taskEt}, ''), task_rst = CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskStatus}, ''), '대기') = '진행중' AND (#{taskRst} IS NULL OR #{taskRst} = '') THEN CURDATE() WHEN #{taskStatus} = '대기' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(#{taskRst}, '') END, task_ret = CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskStatus}, ''), '대기') = '완료' AND (#{taskRet} IS NULL OR #{taskRet} = '') THEN CURDATE() WHEN #{taskStatus} = '대기' OR #{taskStatus} = '진행중' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(#{taskRet}, '') END, task_asi = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskAsi}, ''), task_asi), task_rate = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{taskRate}, ''), task_rate), pjt_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{pjtId}, ''), pjt_id) WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.selectDesign */ t.task_id as taskId, t.task_name as taskName, t.task_des as taskDes, t.task_status as taskStatus, t.is_test as isTest, t.is_design as isDesign, t.pt_task_id as ptTaskId, t.de_task_id as deTaskId, t.task_depth as taskDepth, t.task_st, t.task_et, t.task_rst, t.task_ret, t.task_asi as taskAsi, t.task_rate as taskRate, t.pjt_id as pjtId, t.user_id as userId, pt.task_name as ptTaskName -- 상위 업무명 (조인으로 가져오기) FROM project_task t LEFT JOIN project_task pt ON t.pt_task_id = pt.task_id -- 상위 업무와 조인 WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.design.selectListDesign */ taskId, taskName, taskDes, taskStatus, isTest, isDesign, ptTaskId, deTaskId, taskDepth, taskSt, taskEt, taskRst, taskRet, taskAsi, taskRate, pjtId, userId, ptTaskName FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT t.task_id as taskId, t.task_name as taskName, t.task_des as taskDes, t.task_status as taskStatus, t.is_test as isTest, t.is_design as isDesign, t.pt_task_id as ptTaskId, t.de_task_id as deTaskId, t.task_depth as taskDepth, t.task_st as taskSt, t.task_et as taskEt, t.task_rst as taskRst, t.task_ret as taskRet, t.task_asi as taskAsi, t.task_rate as taskRate, t.pjt_id as pjtId, t.user_id as userId, pt.task_name as ptTaskName -- 상위 업무명 (조인으로 가져오기) FROM project_task t LEFT JOIN project_task pt ON t.pt_task_id = pt.task_id -- 상위 업무와 조인 WHERE t.pjt_id = #{pjtId} AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_design = 0
AND t.task_id like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskId}, '%')
AND t.pt_task_id like CONCAT('%', #{scPtTaskId}, '%')
AND t.task_name like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskName}, '%')
AND t.task_status like CONCAT('%', #{scTaskStatus}, '%')
AND t.is_test = #{scIsTest}
ORDER BY t.task_depth, t.task_id -- 정렬 조건 추가 ) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
